I say "HTTP response" when I talk about my computer project. I say "status code" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use HTTP request, HTTP response, and status code. At the end, I say: I can use HTTP request clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“HTTP 请求与响应”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。HTTP request：HTTP 请求，客户端发给服务器的网络消息。示例：I learned how to use "H T T P request" in a computer task.HTTP response：HTTP 响应，服务器返回给客户端的结果。示例：I learned how to use "H T T P response" in a computer task.status code：状态码，用数字表示请求处理结果。示例：I learned how to use "status code" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“负责人和提醒”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。assignee：负责人，被指定处理事项的人。示例：Our team uses "assignee" to keep the project clear.assign an issue：分配问题单，把事项交给某个人处理。示例：Our team uses "assign an issue" to keep the project clear.mention a teammate：提及队友，用 @ 提醒某位成员。示例：Our team uses "mention a teammate" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
